titulo: I will have finished, I would have gone
intro: Two compound tenses: the future perfect and the conditional perfect.
p.habría: I would have, he/she would have (auxiliary)
p.habrá pasado: can have happened, will have happened
b1.texto:
The **future perfect** is **habré, habrás, habrá, habremos, habréis, habrán** + participle. It is something finished before a point in the future.

- **Para el viernes habré terminado.**
- Dentro de un año **nos habremos mudado**.

It is also a guess about the recent past, just as the simple future is a guess about now.

- No contesta. **Habrá salido.** (he must have gone out)

The **conditional perfect** is **habría, habrías, habría, habríamos, habríais, habrían** + participle. It is what would have happened, and did not.

- Yo **habría ido**, pero no pude.
- En tu lugar, yo no **habría dicho** nada.

A reproach uses it too: ¡me lo **habrías podido** decir!
b3.f0: When do you finish the project?
b3.f1: By Friday I'll have finished it.
b3.f2: Marta hasn't come today. What can have happened?
b3.f3: She must have missed the train. She didn't arrive on time yesterday either.
b3.f4: In her place I would have let people know.
b3.f5: You're right. I would have called too.
b5.pregunta: Complete: by Monday I will have finished.
b5.o0.refuerzo: Finished before a future point: future perfect.
b5.o1.refuerzo: Habría terminado is would have finished.
b5.o2.refuerzo: He terminado is already finished now.
b6.pregunta: He isn't answering. Guess: he must have gone out.
b6.o0.refuerzo: The future perfect is a guess about the recent past.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Habría salido is a guess about an earlier past, or would have.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Haya needs a trigger for the subjunctive.
b7.pregunta: Complete: in your place, I would have gone.
b7.o0.refuerzo: What would have happened: conditional perfect.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Habré ido is will have gone.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Había ido says it really happened.
b8.o0.refuerzo: A guess about what has happened.
b8.o2.refuerzo: That is habría perdido el tren.
b9.traduccion: By Friday I will have finished it.
b10.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write what you will have achieved in five years' time, and what you would have done differently in the last five.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Speculate aloud about why a friend has not answered your messages: Habrá perdido…, se le habrá…
